# acli-py alias

Save a query or a command line under a name; run it as `acli-py @name`.


## `acli-py alias list`

List the aliases: the TUI's views (queries) and saved command lines.

```text
acli-py alias list [OPTIONS]
```

| Option | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--json` |  | Print JSON. |
| `--output` `[table\|json\|csv\|keys\|jsonl\|markdown]` |  | How to print: table, json, csv, markdown, or keys / jsonl (one per line, for pipes). |


## `acli-py alias set`

Save a query, or a whole command line, under a name.

A value starting with a command (`issue`, `sprint`…) is a command line; anything else is a
query for `issue search`, which the TUI also shows as a view.

```text
acli-py alias set NAME VALUE [OPTIONS]
```

```sh
acli-py alias set mine '@me is:open sort:-priority'
acli-py alias set board-7 sprint report --board 7
acli-py @mine --fields key,due
```

| Option | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `NAME` | required | The alias: run it as @NAME. |
| `VALUE` | required | A query ('@me is:open'), or a command line. |


## `acli-py alias delete`

Forget an alias (built-in views stay).

```text
acli-py alias delete NAME [OPTIONS]
```

| Option | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `NAME` | required | The alias to forget. |
